images.actual_source_analysis: One pale sage-green step-through scooter is parked in a three-quarter side view facing right, on its center stand. A plain weathered concrete wall forms the background, with one small dark wall lamp high at right casting warm light downward. Leafy branches and a softly pink-blue dusk sky appear above the wall. Dry cracked paving and a few leaves surround the scooter; no rider or other vehicle.
